The Shanghai Gold Stock Exchange, Ltd.
5 KIUKIANG ROAD.

Shanghai, July 24th, 1951.

The Commissioner,
Commissioner's Office,
18 Hankow Road,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir:-
As a result of a conversation between our Mr.
P. S. Zee and Deputy Commissioner Mr. R. O. Alers
yesterday afternoon, I am instructed to request you
to appoint two armed Chinese detectives for duty at
this Exchange taking effect from the first of August,
1951. They will be required for duty from 8:30 A. M.
to 6 P. M. during week-days, holidays excepted. We shall
be appreciated to hear from you as to their monthly pay
and the manner of payment.

I am, Sir,
Yours faithfully,
THE SHANGHAI GOLD STOCK EXCHANGE, LTD.,

page_data.en:
Date July 16th, 1931.

(C. & S.B.) Office Notes

Sir,

The facts and details of the dispute and subsequent fight
or assault which forms the subject of this letter are as
follows:-

In the early part of 1929, the Gold Bar Exchange Associa-
tion employed two supervisors whose sole duty is is to ensure
that only registered brokers enter the pit where actual busi-
ness is transacted. The names of these supervisors are,
Dzung Vung Me ( ) and Yu Ah Vung ( ). Both
were engaged by Mr. Zee Poo Sung ( ) through ex-C.D.S.
89 Mau Dzang Sz. Neither have any actual criminal record
but the first-mentioned was on one occasion arrested by the
French Police for assault but released from the Police Station,
and the latter was charged from Dixwell Road Station with
complicity in an armed kidnapping committed on Peking Road.
He was in custody under remand for several weeks but eventually
discharged from Court.

About November, 1930, it was decided to employ two addi-
tional supervisors and Zia Siau Mau ( ) and Tsiang Ah
Zen ( ) were taken into service. Again ex-C.D.S. 89
was the enlisting agent but the first-mentioned is a brother
of C.D.S.I. Zia Sz Zien (Central Station) and the latter was
formerly an assistant to D.I. Loh Kung Sung (Dixwell Road)
who is the elder brother of C.D.S. 153 Loh Kung Ti (Central
Station).

There appears to have been no trouble until the end of
June, 1931, when, owing to the unusual fluctuations on the
exchange, it was found necessary to provide further against
the excitement daily prevalent in the Exchange. Four addi-
tional supervisors were urgently required and from a Chinese
psychological point of view, the initial mistake was made in
the manner this extra help was engaged.

Mr. Zee Poo Sung, manager of the Exchange, entrusted

（刑事与特别股）办公室笔记

先生，

构成此信主题的争端及随后的斗殴
或袭击的事实和细节如下：-

1929年初，金条交易所协会雇佣了两名监督员，其唯一职责是确保
只有注册经纪人进入进行实际交易的
交易池。这两名监督员的名字是，
Dzung Vung Me（ ）和 Yu Ah Vung（ ）。两人
均由 Zee Poo Sung（ ）先生通过前华籍高级探目
89号 Mau Dzang Sz 雇佣。两人都没有实际的犯罪记录，
但前者曾因袭击罪被法国警察逮捕一次，但从警察局释放，
后者曾在狄司威路捕房被指控参与发生在北京路的一起武装绑架案。
他被还押拘留数周，但最终被法庭释放。

大约在1930年11月，决定再雇佣两名
额外的监督员，于是 Zia Siau Mau（ ）和 Tsiang Ah
Zen（ ）被录用。再次由前华籍高级探目89号
作为招募代理人，但前者是华籍高级副探目（C.D.S.I.）谢思坚（中央捕房）的兄弟，
后者曾是探长 罗公松（狄司威路）的助手，
而罗公松是华籍高级探目（C.D.S.）153号 罗公弟（中央捕房）的兄长。

直到1931年6月底似乎都没有出现麻烦，当时，由于
交易所行情异常波动，发现有必要进一步防范
交易所内每日普遍存在的激动情绪。急需四名
额外的监督员，而从中国人的心理角度来看，
在雇佣这些额外帮手的方式上犯了最初的错误。

交易所经理 Zee Poo Sung 先生委托

（左侧手写批注：被绑匪谴责 证据不足 Reap）
（左侧手写批注：因绑架案被革职）

(C. & S.B.) Office Notes
（批：Savage ?）
Tsiang Ah Zen (8 months service) with the mission of engaging
the extra help and Dzung Vung Me (2½ years service) undoubted-
ly considered this a slight on his character or reputaion.
Tsiang Ah Zen approached ex-C.D.S. 89 and four additional
supervisors were engaged on July 3. There is no actual
evidence or admission on the point but it is quite conceivable
that some of the four were assistants to C.D.S. 153.
At about 4.30 p.m. on July 6, a fight occurred, or an
assault was committed in an alleyway adjoining the Exchange.
According to Tsiang Ah Zen who personally, or by proxy, was
the aggressor, it was a fight between himself and Dzung Vung
Me. If the latter's version is to be believed, it was an
assault committed by Tsiang Ah Zen and four others. There
are no independent witnesses and the only common ground is
that, whether it was a fight or an assault, the trouble was
occasioned by Dzung Vung Me making disparaging remarks on the
character and appearance of the help recently engaged through
Tsiang Ah Zen. Dzung Vung Me sustained slight bruising of
the hands (in falling) and the chest and lost a gold watch
during the melee. He reported the occurence at Central
Police Station almost immediately and an entry of his compla-
int was made by C.D.I. Mason and S.I. Tabrum. He was sent
to hospital and medical certificate in re. examination is
attached herewith. He again attended at Central Staion the
following afternoon and was interviewed by C.D.I. Mason who
called in C.D.S.I. Zia Sz Zien, C.D.S. 153 and ex-C.D.S. 89.
It was then the allegedly aggrieved person Dzung Vung Me
withdrew his complaint and in the course of enquiries made
from this office, it transpires that :-
(1) C.D.S. 153 was not present during the assault
or fight.
(2) The gold watch lost or stolen during the melee

额外帮手，而 Dzung Vung Me（服务2½年）无疑
认为这是对其品格或声誉的轻视。
Tsiang Ah Zen 联系了前华籍高级探目89号，并于7月3日雇佣了四名额外的监督员。
在此问题上没有实际证据或供认，但完全可以想象，
这四个人中有些是华籍高级探目153号的助手。
7月6日下午4:30左右，在交易所附近的一条小巷里
发生了斗殴，或有人遭到袭击。
根据 Tsiang Ah Zen 的说法（无论是亲自还是通过代理人），
他是挑衅者，这是他本人与 Dzung Vung
Me 之间的斗殴。如果相信后者的说法，则是 Tsiang Ah Zen 和其他四人
实施的袭击。没有独立证人，唯一的共同点是，
无论是斗殴还是袭击，麻烦都是由 Dzung Vung Me 对
最近通过 Tsiang Ah Zen 雇佣的帮手的品格和外貌发表贬低言论引起的。
Dzung Vung Me 手部（摔倒时）和胸部受轻伤，
并在混战中丢失了一块金表。他几乎立即向中央
捕房报告了此事，华籍探长 Mason 和副巡官 Tabrum
记录了他的投诉。他被送往医院，随函附上有关检查的医疗证明。
次日下午他再次来到中央捕房，并由华籍探长 Mason 进行了问询，
Mason 叫来了华籍高级副探目 谢思坚、华籍高级探目153号和前华籍高级探目89号。
此时，自称受害者的 Dzung Vung Me
撤回了投诉，在本办公室进行的调查过程中，查明：-
(1) 华籍高级探目153号在袭击
或斗殴期间不在场。
(2) 混战中丢失或被盗的金表

engaged through the Police would not be acquainted with the

that brokers wear distinguishing badges and apply at the
office for an emergency badge in cases of lapse of memory but
Mr. Zee apologetically remarked that this would be too
systematic a procedure for Chinese brokers to conform to.

C. & S.
No. S. F. D. 2869
Date 4 . 11 . 37

Messrs. R.M.J. Martin & R.C. Aiers,
Police Department,
Corner of Honan & Hankow Road.

Gentlemen,

We beg to inform you that C.D.C.153 Loh
Kung-ti, concurrent chief supervisor in the Gold
Bar Exchange at No.3 Kiukiang Road with a salary of
$80 per mensem from the latter position only, came to
the above exchange with four of his seconds at 4.30 p.m.
on the 6th of the present month and assaulted and
injured a man named Chen, one of the supervisors in
the exchange. Loh and his men threatened their
victim with two pistols and robbed him of one gold
chain and one gold watch. The complainant went to
the Central Station and lodged a complaint. The
foreign Inspector, the foreign detective and the Chinese
gateman notified the Detective Office, and, as C.D.C.
153 Loh Kung-ti is the 'pupil' of the Chinese Senior
Detective Hsia Dah Mao, the report was rejected. In
the same evening Hsia Dah Mao and his pupil, Loh Kung-
ti arranged with and secured the understanding of the
foreign Senior Detective, so, when the complainant
went to the Station at 9 a.m. on the 7th, he was again
turned out. Hsia Dah Mao also asked the foreign Senior
Detective not to report the case to the D.D.O. nor to
any other superior officer, for a report on the assault
case, it is feared, will either result in Loh's transfer
or jeopardise the prospect of his promotion which has
been recommended. According to Loh's own words he has
drawn six months salary from the gold bar exchange and
used it to thank the foreign Senior Detective.

From the above we can see that we shall have
no hope of promotion to the rank of Sergeant, because
we are not like C.D.C.153 who has both influence and

诸位先生：

谨此告知，中央捕房华籍侦探第153号罗公迪（Loh Kung-ti，音译），兼任九江路3号金条交易所总督察，仅该兼职月薪为80元，于本月6日下午4时30分携四名手下前往上述交易所，殴打并致伤该交易所督察之一陈姓男子。罗及其手下以两把手枪威胁受害人，抢走金链一条及金表一只。投诉人前往中央捕房报案。外籍巡官、外籍探员及华籍门警通知了侦探股，但因中央捕房华籍侦探第153号罗公迪系华籍高级探员夏达茂（Hsia Dah Mao，音译）之“门生”，该报告被驳回。同日晚上，夏达茂与其门生罗公迪与外籍高级探员达成默契，故当投诉人于7日上午9时再次前往捕房时，又被拒之门外。夏达茂还要求外籍高级探员不要将此案上报至侦探处处长（D.D.O.）或任何其他上级官员，因为据信，若上报这起殴打案，将导致罗被调职，或危及其已获推荐的晋升前景。据罗自称，他从金条交易所支取了六个月薪水，用于酬谢外籍高级探员。

由此可知，我们晋升巡长一职已无希望，因为我们不像中央捕房华籍侦探第153号那样既有势力又有
